base64-invalid.rationale: Python and MailParser discard invalid alphabet byte ! and decode hello. MoonMIME marks decoding unavailable with MOONMIME_BASE64. Deliberate conservative decoding policy.

base64-unpadded.rationale: All payload hashes agree. MoonMIME explicitly records recovered padding; this is a policy control, not an observed payload divergence.

qp-invalid.rationale: Python and MailParser preserve abc=ZZ. MoonMIME returns no decoded payload for a malformed escape. Deliberate conservative decoding policy.

unknown-transfer.rationale: Other parsers expose original bytes as payload. MoonMIME keeps encoded evidence but does not claim an unknown encoding was decoded.

duplicate-type.rationale: Observed type selection and hashes agree on this input. MoonMIME records duplicate-singleton-header; no claim that these parsers diverge on this fixture.

encoded-message.rationale: MoonMIME retains an opaque message entity; Python exposes a nested text entity; MailParser exposes a decoded message attachment. A documented structural scope difference, not proof of exploitability.

bare-lf.rationale: Observed types and hashes agree. MoonMIME records nine bare-line-feed diagnostics; compatible acceptance is not a strict validity claim.

missing-close.rationale: Observed hashes agree; MoonMIME records missing-closing-boundary-accepted. This fixture establishes recovery visibility, not an observed hash divergence.
